original.target_description: Study 1: change in proactive coping for Beyond Good Intentions course participants versus control patients, assessed by the group × time repeated-measures ANOVA. Analytic participants stated a goal at both T1 and T2.

n.sample_role: Participants in the proactive-coping repeated-measures analysis: 64 course participants and 73 control patients.
n.exclusions: Restricted to patients stating a goal at both T1 and T2; the 180 questionnaire completers (78 intervention, 102 control) are not the target analytic sample. Recruitment allocated 119 intervention and 108 control; intervention dropouts were 30 before and 11 during the course, and control dropouts were four due to ill-health and two due to form-completion difficulties.
n.location: Postprint pp. 6–7, Analysis and Results; final proactive-coping/goal-attainment analysis sample stated across the page break.
n.quote: 64 course ... participants were compared with 73 control patients who had stated a goal at both T1 and T2.
